# Huruma Children's Trust (Canada)

> Registered Canadian charity based in Collingwood, Ontario. Raises awareness and funds across Canada for orphaned and vulnerable children at Huruma Children's Home & School in Ngong, Kenya. CRA charity registration number: 830771770RR0001.

## Entity clarity (important)

- **This website** is Huruma Children's Trust (Canada) — a Canadian registered charity.
- **Not the same organization** as Huruma Trust Fund in Kenya.
- Canadian donations to this Trust receive Canadian charitable tax receipts.
- The home, schools, and clinic in Kenya are operated locally by Huruma Trust Fund (a registered Community Based Organization / CBO in Ngong town, outskirts of Nairobi).
- Official Kenya website: https://hurumatrustfund.org/
- Social media linked from this Canadian site (Facebook, Instagram, YouTube, and the Kenya website icon) belong to **Huruma Kenya**, not the Canadian Trust.

## What the Canadian Trust does

- Mandate: raise awareness and funds in Canada for Huruma Children's Home in Ngong, Kenya.
- Board and operations in Canada are volunteer-run; gifts go to support the children.
- Location: 165 Fourth Street East, Collingwood, Ontario, Canada L9Y 1T9
- Email: donnamansfield25@yahoo.ca
- Phone: 705 445 9894
- About 300+ children live at the home full-time; additional children from local communities come for school and meals.

## What Huruma Trust Fund (Kenya) operates

Registered CBO in Ngong, Kenya, catering for:

- Huruma Children's Orphanage – Ngong
- Ngong Huruma Primary, Junior & Secondary Schools
- Ngong Huruma Clinic

Vision (Kenya): Every child who comes to Huruma will have a personal relationship with Jesus Christ and excel in academics, so they are fully equipped to become future Christian leaders.

Mission (Kenya): Empower children in need to become productive members of society through rehabilitation, education, and self-reliance skills.

Objectives (Kenya): basic needs (food, shelter, clothing, security); formal and informal education; life skills, moral and spiritual guidance and counselling; parental love, care, and affection.

Values (Kenya): Integrity, Self-discipline, Teamwork, and Love.

Mottos (Kenya): Orphanage — “Children are a Heritage from God”; Schools — “Every Learner Counts”.

- Tax receipts issued for Canadian donations (830771770RR0001)
- Cheques payable as stated on the donate page; mail to the Collingwood address above

## Founder context

Mama Zipporah (with Pastor Isaac Kamau) founded Huruma Children's Home in Kenya. Canadian supporters and Huruma Children's Trust (Canada) walk alongside that work through awareness and fundraising in Canada.
